jobs.occupation: Service Desk Analyst – Windows & MS Office
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Provide first-line technical support for workstations, mobile devices, and communication tools.
• Manage day-to-day incident tickets and ensure consistent follow-up as part of a structured support team.
• Develop and maintain the knowledge base by drafting practical checklists and troubleshooting templates.
• Collaborate with second and third-line specialists to improve internal procedures and technical documentation.
• Assist end-users with functional queries related to office productivity suites and collaboration platforms.
• Participate in the preparation and configuration of IT hardware and materials.

Requirements

• 5+ years of professional experience in a service desk or technical support team.
• Proven expertise in Windows workstation troubleshooting and configuration.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and SharePoint.
• Practical knowledge of Atlassian Jira and Confluence or similar ticket management and documentation platforms.
• Demonstrated experience in drafting Standard Operational Procedures (SOP) and technical documentation.
• You possess a formal educational background in Information Technology.
• You're well-organized, structured, and punctual in administrative follow-up.
• You bring a proactive approach to independent problem-solving and investigation.
• You are a native speaker of Dutch or French with bilingual proficiency in the other and professional working knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• ITIL certification.
• Experience with Microsoft Teams and mobile phone troubleshooting.
• Professional experience in other IT functional domains.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager IT – B2B Software Integration
jobs.description:
Lead the implementation of software solutions at external clients, across functional scoping, run and upgrade projects.

Project Manager IT | B2B Software Integration | Brussels

Our client is a Belgian company specialised in integrating and implementing software solutions at its clients’ sites, recognised for its strong presence among demanding organisations.

What makes it stand out? A portfolio of strategic accounts backed by a framework contract recently renewed for six years, giving it rare visibility over its projects and its teams.

Its activity combines run, ticketing and upgrade projects on heavily customised application platforms, deployed and maintained at the client’s site.

As it grows, the company is strengthening its delivery management team and is looking for a senior Project Manager IT with a background in software integration.

The job

• Reporting to the practice lead, you take operational ownership of several client accounts and the implementation projects attached to them.
• You manage the relationship between the client, the internal teams and an external technical partner, while keeping a firm grip on the functional content of the projects.Role
• Manage the budgets, deadlines and contractual commitments of your accounts.
• Work with the business analyst on scoping client needs: challenge requests, measure them against the platform’s capabilities and decide which customisations to retain.
• Steer the external partner delivering the technical teams, and coordinate exchanges between client, partner and internal teams.
• Follow up on run and ticketing, and lead upgrade and evolution projects.
• Identify contractual, budgetary and operational risks, and bring the trade-offs to the client.
Profile
• Senior experience on the vendor side — with an integrator, a software vendor or a consultancy — implementing software solutions at external clients.
• Comfortable with the functional side of projects: you understand the solutions you deploy and can challenge an analysis or a specification rather than only coordinate. A background in functional analysis is an asset.
• Fluent English is essential; administrative rigour, diplomacy and political judgement when dealing with demanding clients.

At Telenet Business, our business customers always come first. With our strong portfolio of connectivity and ICT solutions, we help companies, organizations and government institutions collaborate seamlessly, stay secure and perform at their best in the digital world.

 
As a Business Consultant within B2B Delivery & Services Excellence, you help transform our order-to-cash and customer service management processes, ensuring our employees have the right tools and processes to support customers effectively. You connect business teams with strategic and transformational programs, technology teams, product owners, external partners and business analysts.

 
Ready to come and do your thing with us?

Your role as Transformation Business Consultant

 
• Drive successful transformation by representing the business in major programs and connecting business teams with technology teams, product owners, analysts and external partners.
 
• Represent the business in strategic and transformational programs across order-to-cash and customer service processes.
 
• Translate business strategy and operational needs into clear priorities, roadmaps and valuable outcomes.
 
• Align stakeholders across business, technology, architecture, product teams and external partners.
 
• Shape business cases, validate benefits and explore solutions that create measurable value.
 
• Ensure effective delivery and adoption by involving the right experts in analysis, testing and training.
 
• Report clearly on progress, risks, issues and outcomes to business owners and leadership.

Your profile as Transformation Business Consultant

 
• Brings experience in business transformation and quickly builds a strong understanding of processes, customers and operations.
 
• Combines analytical strength with a data-driven approach to priorities, decisions and value creation.
 
• Has excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including with leadership.
 
• Works autonomously, connects the dots and remains effective in complex and ambiguous environments.
 
• Has sufficient digital and technical affinity to collaborate with technology teams and partners; knowledge of telecom, ICT, agile, ITIL or PRINCE2 is an advantage.
 
• Is fluent in written and spoken Dutch and English.

Our offer to you
At Telenet group, you get more than just an attractive gross salary. We strongly believe in results and ownership: we expect commitment and impact, and we’ll give you the trust and freedom you need to make a difference. What you achieve truly matters.

In addition to a thirteenth-month salary and holiday pay, you can count on an extensive package of extra benefits that supports you in your daily life as well as at work.

An overview of our benefits:

 
• Mobility budget: compose your own mobility plan, you can opt for a company car or alternative mobility solutions
 
• Meal vouchers and eco vouchers
 
• Telework allowance or net expense allowance
 
• Mobile phone, mobile subscription and laptop
 
• Employee discount on your home internet, digital TV, and mobile subscriptions
 
• Collective bonus and individual bonus (aligned with your performance)
 
• A comprehensive flexible benefits plan with a wide range of options: from financial benefits and additional time off to a bicycle lease, supplemental ambulatory insurance for you and your family, and IT or office equipment 
 
• Hospitalization insurance (including an ambulatory plan) and group insurance
 
• 20 days of paid leave and 12 compensatory days off

• Brings experience in business transformation and quickly builds a strong understanding of processes, customers and operations.

• Combines analytical strength with a data-driven approach to priorities, decisions and value creation.

• Has excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including with leadership.

• Works autonomously, connects the dots and remains effective in complex and ambiguous environments.

• Has sufficient digital and technical affinity to collaborate with technology teams and partners; knowledge of telecom, ICT, agile, ITIL or PRINCE2 is an advantage.

• Is fluent in written and spoken Dutch and English.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. • Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.Working hours are from Monday to Friday in a two-shift system: 
• Morning shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
• Afternoon shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You perform well in a team and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You are stress-resistant and thrive in a production environment where pace is important. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

• You are conscientious and enjoy working efficiently. 
• You are an excellent multitasker. 
• You can work well both independently and as part of a team. 
• Working at a fast pace is not a problem for you. 
• You are enthusiastic and eager to learn. 
• You are specifically looking for a job on a permanent night shift. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant - International and Dynamic Environment
jobs.description:
Company Presentation

We are recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing company operating in the service sector linked to healthcare, located in the Brussels region.

This human-sized structure operates in a dynamic and modern environment, where innovation and service quality play a central role. The team, made up of around ten employees, works in a professional yet friendly atmosphere, with an accessible management style focused on collaboration.

The company stands out for its financial stability, continuous growth, and a corporate culture built on trust, autonomy, and teamwork. Internal initiatives and strong cohesion between departments contribute to a pleasant and motivating working environment.

Missions / Responsibilities

• Oversee the full accounting scope, both general and analytical, across multiple entities, ensuring accuracy and compliance of financial data.
• Record and follow up on day-to-day transactions (purchase and sales invoices, financial operations, and various accounting entries).
• Prepare and submit VAT returns, ensuring full compliance with Belgian tax regulations.
• Actively participate in monthly and annual closings, including period-end entries and cut-off operations.
• Perform bank reconciliations and ensure proper monitoring of customer and supplier balances.
• Carry out account reconciliations and ensure consistency of accounting records.
• Contribute to financial reporting and the preparation of dashboards for management.
• Participate in the continuous improvement and optimisation of accounting processes and internal tools.
• Collaborate with internal teams and, when necessary, with external partners (accounting firms, auditors, etc.).

Profile Required

• Education Degree in accounting, finance, or equivalent through experience.
• Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in general accounting, ideally in a multi-entity or international environment.
• Technical skills Strong command of accounting tools and Excel. Good knowledge of accounting closings and Belgian tax obligations. ERP knowledge is an asset.
• Languages Fluent in French and strong professional level of English, both written and spoken.
• Personal qualities Rigorous, autonomous, analytical mindset, and strong team spirit. You are also proactive and solution-oriented.

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

Jobomschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.Administrative Management She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.Coordination She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.Reception & Customer Relations As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.Information Management She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.Support to Management She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow-up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision-making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Team Leader Design Office - Dilbeek - Fast Growing Company
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian engineering group with offices located in the Dilbeek area, offering a modern and easily accessible work environment. You will join a structured technical department within a stable and growing industrial organisation.

Jobomschrijving

• Coach and develop a team of 10 technical specialists
• Organise and oversee the daily planning of the technical office
• Provide technical advice to clients, project managers and internal teams
• Prepare and validate cost calculations and technical quotations
• Analyse technical drawings, specifications and client requirements
• Manage client communication regarding ongoing orders and changes
• Drive process improvements and automation initiatives

• Master's degree in civil engineering, architecture or a technical field
• Minimum 8 years of proven experience in a technical office environment
• Native Dutch speaker with good command of English and French
• Strong analytical mindset with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Initial experience in team management or coaching is required

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing company investing in the expansion and modernization of one of its production sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate engineering activities from concept and feasibility studies through execution.
• Act as the interface between engineering, production, and project management teams.
• Support the delivery of multidisciplinary installations, including civil works, mechanical equipment, utilities, and electrical systems.
• Monitor project planning, technical coordination, and execution to ensure objectives are met.
• Contribute to the successful implementation of brownfield CAPEX projects within an operational production environment.

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, or a multidisciplinary engineering background with a strong civil engineering foundation.
• Proven experience as a Project Engineer on industrial CAPEX projects, ideally in brownfield environments.
• Strong understanding of civil engineering with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary technical activities.
• Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
• Fluent in Dutch and English (mandatory).

Our client based in Nivelles is an international and fast-growing company operating in the logistics and supply chain sector. Renowned for its collaborative culture, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to talent development, the company offers an excellent environment for young professionals looking to launch their career in Supply Chain.To strengthen their operations team, they are currently looking for a motivated Junior Supply Chain Graduate eager to learn, grow, and gain exposure to end-to-end supply chain activities.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior Supply Chain Graduate, you will support various supply chain functions and gain valuable hands-on experience across planning, logistics, inventory management, and operations.Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting demand planning and forecasting activities
• Monitoring inventory levels and helping optimize stock availability
• Coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, and transportation partners
• Tracking deliveries and ensuring smooth order fulfillment
• Assisting with data analysis and preparing supply chain performance reports
• Identifying operational improvement opportunities and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, Customer Service, Logistics, and Operations
• Participating in supply chain projects related to process optimization, digitalization, and performance enhancement
• Ensuring accurate data management within ERP and supply chain systems
• Contributing to the achievement of service, quality, and cost objectives

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Engineering, Economics, Operations Management, or a related field
• Recent graduate or first professional experience within Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or Planning
• Strong analytical mindset with good problem-solving abilities
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
• Comfortable working with data and supply chain KPIs
• Eager to learn and develop within an international environment
• Organized, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with different stakeholders
• Team player with a positive and hands-on attitude

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?
 

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.
 

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
